info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Realgar Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Realgar Pendant Details Management API facilitates the creation and organization of detailed information regarding Realgar Pendant items within a catalog. This endpoint allows users to input comprehensive specifications, descriptions, and attributes pertinent to the Realgar Pendant, ensuring accurate representation in the product catalog. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and retail inventory systems needing structured product data. This API enhances product visibility and aids in efficient inventory management by providing a seamless way to input detailed pendant information.

post.summary: Create details for a Realgar pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information about a Realgar pendant, including its specifications and properties. Provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully register the details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to the Realgar Pendant. It should contain all the necessary fields required for processing the request effectively.
